# databasics

> Australian DAM and PIM provider delivering Canto cloud solutions for digital asset and product information management across enterprise, government, and nonprofit sectors.

databasics is a Sydney-based digital asset management company established in 1989, specializing in Canto DAM and PIM implementations for Australian and New Zealand organizations. The company provides personalized onboarding, training, and support services tailored to industry-specific workflows.

## Key Topics

- Canto DAM
- Digital Asset Management
- Product Information Management (PIM)
- Content Organization
- Brand Asset Management
- Canto Builder
- Cloud DAM
- Compliance & Security
- Omnichannel Management
- Content Management
- Australia & New Zealand
- DAM Implementation
- Brand Consistency
- InDesign Integration
- Canva Integration

## Core Products

- [Canto DAM Software in Australia](https://www.databasics.com.au/canto-dam): Main product page for Canto cloud DAM platform with features and workflows.
- [Canto PIM - Product Information Management | Canto | Australia](https://www.databasics.com.au/canto-pim-australia): Canto PIM product page for unified product data and asset management.
- [Canto Builder plugin for InDesign and Canva](https://www.databasics.com.au/lp/builder): Product page for Canto Builder plugin enabling automated design workflows.

## Industry Solutions

- [Digital Asset Management for Retail | Australia](https://www.databasics.com.au/digital-asset-management/retail): DAM + PIM solution for retail omnichannel brand and product management.
- [Digital Asset Management for Local Government in Australia](https://www.databasics.com.au/digital-asset-management/local-government): DAM solution for local government councils with governance and security.
- [Digital Asset Management for State Government | Australia](https://www.databasics.com.au/digital-asset-management/state-government): DAM solution for state government agencies with compliance and security.
- [Digital Asset Management for schools and universities in Australia](https://www.databasics.com.au/digital-asset-management/education): DAM solution page for schools, universities, and educational institutions.
- [Digital Asset Management for Manufacturing | Australia](https://www.databasics.com.au/digital-asset-management/manufacturing): DAM + PIM solution for manufacturing brand consistency and product launches.
- [Digital Asset Management (DAM) for Small Business in Australia | Canto](https://www.databasics.com.au/digital-asset-management/small-business): DAM solution page tailored for small business workflows and compliance.
- [Digital Asset Management for not-for-profit and charities](https://www.databasics.com.au/digital-asset-management/not-profit-organisation): DAM solution page for not-for-profit organizations and charities sector.
- [Digital Asset Management for Travel and Tourism in Australia | Canto](https://www.databasics.com.au/digital-asset-management/travel-and-tourism): DAM solution for travel, tourism, and RTO content distribution needs.
- [Digital Asset Management for Construction in Australia | Canto](https://www.databasics.com.au/digital-asset-management/construction): DAM solution for construction industry project and marketing asset management.
